items.sentence: This year's harvest filled twelve straw baskets with golden rice.
Students illustrate the story's main scene so pictures match the text.
Few climbers dare to cross the narrow rope bridge alone.
The long voyage to the island took eleven windy days.
Conventional wooden looms work slower than the new electric machines.
Contemporary dancers mix new steps with the old village rhythm.
The printing revolution let ordinary families own their first books.
Village cooperation rebuilt the shared well after the dry summer.
Careful training helped the climbers conquer the steep mountain path.
The stone tower stays stable because opposite pushes balance each other.
